title: Yes @Biappi is correct a small group of enthusiasts are pushing back against the hegemony of big search engines that demand you conform to their data
summary: Yes @Biappi is correct a small group of enthusiasts are pushing back against the hegemony of big search engines that demand you conform to their data standards. Okay defining success one domain at a time. If you believe plain old semantic HTML makes sense do it.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Yes @Biappi is correct a small group of enthusiasts are pushing back against the hegemony of big search engines that demand you conform to their data standards.

Okay defining success one domain at a time.

If you believe plain old semantic HTML makes sense do it.
